name: AUG Burst Group
info:
Changes the trigger grouping of your UAR favoring a 3-round burst over full auto.
Slightly raises headshot and torso damage while also slightly reducing recoil.

name: Gyrojet Full-Auto Conversion
info:
You ever wonder how the Grand Federation had made it to the moon? Rockets of course!
This fits your Gyrojet with the capability of firing in automatic. Trading off semi-auto performance for full-auto rocket power!

name: CSMG Burst Trigger Group
info:
Change the trigger group of your XM633 to fire in a 3-round burst and semi-automatic.
Making it by technicality, the M639 SMG. Easier to control recoil.

name: Heavy Buffer
info: A heavy hydralic buffer that slows down the rate of fire of the M635 to a slightly more controllable level, providing better recoil control.

name: 30rd Mag
info: Expands magazine capacity to hold 30 rounds. Reduced total spare rounds carried, slower reload and walkspeed.

name: M1919 Conversion
info:
Change the internals of your Thompson with those of the experimental M1919 submachine gun.
Expect your firerate to go up, but your handling to drop extensively...

name: 50rd Drum
info: Expands magazine capacity to hold a whopping 50 rounds. This heavy magazine greatly reduces spare rounds carried, slows reload and handling speed, and slows your walkspeed, but at least you'll feel like a mobster.

name: FIVE-0 Full-Auto Trigger Group
info: Change the trigger group of your FIVE-0 to make it fire in full-automatic and semi-automatic. Lowers your firerate, ranges, and increases recoil somewhat.

name: Uzi Light Bolt
info: Installs a lightweight bolt into the Uzi, significantly increasing the weapon's rate of fire. Unfortunately, you lose some controllability in the process.

name: BWC9 Fire Selector Burst
info: Adds a fire selector to your BWC9. Capable of firing in 3 shot burst.

name: MP5K Burst Trigger Group
info:
Change the trigger group of your SMX-9K to fire in a 3-round burst and semi-automatic.
Improves weapon damage to torsos an damage overall giving more breathing room in range if you hit torso shots. Easier to control recoil.

name: Trench Sweeper
info: Change your internals of your Typewriter with those of the experimental M1919 submachine gun. Insanely high fire rate and improves your handling significantly but comes at the cost of a limited 30 round magazine and wild recoil!

name: MP-9 Remove Limiter
info:
Removes the fire rate limiter from your MP-9 allowing it to fire at the full 1500 RPM!
Results in less accuracy and is not compatible with the drum magazine.

name: MP5/10 Burst Trigger Group
info:
Change the trigger group of your SMX-9/10 to fire in a 3-round burst and semi-automatic.
Improves weapon damage and performance in close range but damage drops off faster with poorer damage in range. Easier to control recoil.

name: SL8 Binary
info:
Modify your PL8 with a binary trigger group.

Fires one round when you depress the trigger, and another when you release it. That's double the bullet for every trigger pull!

name: TCR Duplex Binary
info: A binary-trigger group allows you to fire your gun on a trigger pull and to fire again once you let go. Duplex rounds not included.

name: AUG DMR Burst Group
info: Adds a 3-round burst trigger group to the UAR A3M2 for a unique trigger control flavor.

name: SVU-A Conversion Kit
info: Change the internals of your SVU sniper rifle into that of the SVU-A with an extended magazine. Treat it as a hard to control battle rifle (especially in auto which should only be used for emergencies)...

name: Extended Tube
info: A longer magazine for tube-shotguns, increases magazine capacity with lower overall handling.

name: e Shotgun HDS
info:
Adjust your settings to be fit for home defence scenarios.
Weapon is locked to burst fire with adjusted performance.

name: e Shotgun CCS
info:
Adjust your settings to be fit for crowd control scenarios.
Weapon is locked to automatic fire with adjusted performance.

name: Extended Magazine
info: Expands magazine capacity to hold more rounds. Sometimes reduces total spare rounds carried.

name: Heavy Buffer
info:
A heavy buffer tube with a nested spring used in some early XM231 prototypes - dropping the rate of fire to only 200 rounds per minute.

Why would you use this? Why would you want to use this?

name: M16A2 Buffer Stock
info: Uses the buffer tube from a traditional M16A2 to significantly increase your fire rate, destabilizes your recoil and reduces damage performance!

name: M107 Reduced Magazine
info:
A smaller magazine reducing how much ammo you hold.
But improves reload speed and lowers the overall weight of your gun!

info: Expands magazine capacity to hold more rounds. Sometimes reduces total spare rounds carried.

name: AUG HBAR Closed Bolt Conversion
info: Convert your UAR HEAVY to fire from a closed bolt. Reduces weapon firerate and gives it more general accuracy in exchange. Can load an extra round in the chamber!

name: Light Bolt (MG42)
info: The bolt is replaced by a much lighter one, increasing the RPM and some mobility but making the gun harder to control!

name: Heavy Bolt (MG42)
info: The bolt is replaced by a much heavier one, slowing down the RPM and movement but making the gun easier to control.

name: USAS-12 Semi Conversion
info:
Change the internals of your USAS-12 to make it able to fire in semi-automatic like the closed-bolt civilian variant.
Better choke accuracy, but less firerate. Can carry an extra round in the chamber.

name: BOOMBOX Semi Group
info:
Changes the trigger grouping of your Doombox to be semi-automatic only!
Raises headshot & torso damage but reduces fire rate allowing you to play it like a subsonic DMR!

name: HCAR Open bolt
info: Converts your HCAR to be fully automatic but gives up the ability to shoot semi-automatic.

name: Five-Seven Full Auto
info: An aftermarket modification turning the gun into a full-auto machine gun - at the cost of rapidly dumping the contents of the magazine after pulling the trigger.

name: Glock Switch
info: Replaces parts of your G-Series pistol to allow it to fire fully automatic and become a machine gun by law. However, you cannot stop it from firing

name: U416 Binary
info:
Modify your U-527/22 to fit it with a binary trigger group.
A binary trigger fires one round when you hold down the trigger, but also fires again when you let go!
Increases fire rate but reduces headshot damage.

To have the pro mag, you must be a pro.
